REQUEST A DEMO Bad Bunny: Anatomy of a Narrative This report analyzes how discourse surrounding a major cultural moment rapidly evolved into a polarized information environment and opposing narratives were simultaneously amplified through coordinated activity. GUDEA’s analysis demonstrates how cultural flashpoints can become attack surfaces for narrative manipulation, and why understanding who drives narrative velocity is critical for identifying engineered escalation before it reshapes mainstream conversation. OPEN THE REPORT Taylor Swift: Anatomy of a Narrative This report analyzes how a false narrative targeting Taylor Swift was strategically introduced online, escalated through coordinated activity, and ultimately reshaped authentic public discourse across platforms. GUDEA’s analysis demonstrates how narrative manipulation can migrate from fringe spaces into mainstream conversation, and why early detection is critical.
